title: INCREDIBLE ZOOM | Nikon P1000 | Ben Lomond | Scotland
summary: Footage shot with a Nikon P1000 superzoom camera showing extreme optical zoom on distant targets from Ben Lomond in Scotland.
why: Cited as an eye-opening demonstration of how much a consumer camera can resolve at long range, relevant to privacy and surveillance threads.

quote.text: Check out this zoom test and you can see people 3.5 miles away it will blow your mind.
